issues.description: ClaimReview JSON-LD in generate-html.js (line 1513) uses ${counts.total} (our WIN count, currently 72) in the "claimReviewed" field, where it should use ${context.domeClaimedConfirmed} (the dome's own claimed count, 69). This misrepresents what the dome claims: "The dome has 72 confirmed predictions" vs the correct "The dome claims 69 confirmed predictions." The ClaimReview schema is meant to represent the claim being reviewed (dome's own claim), not our entry count.

issues.title: WIN-011: Unnikrishnan framing incorrect - dome uses it offensively, not self-refutingly
issues.description: WIN-011.c10.json curmudgeon-review queue_id=507: current detail_evidence says dome "cites a globe counter-paper against itself" but dome actually uses Unnikrishnan 2001 offensively to rule out rival globe shielding hypothesis. The against-itself framing is factually wrong and undermines the WIN. Needs full reframe: our critique should be that dome misapplies/over-claims Unnikrishnan 2001 to dismiss a legitimate alternative. Route to analyst for EXP-608.

issues.title: WIN-011: "silently" appears 6x across fields - mechanical, weakens impact
issues.description: WIN-011.c10.json curmudgeon-review queue_id=507: "silently" appears 6 times across WIN-011 fields. Dense repetition feels mechanical. As part of ISS-2674/EXP-608 reframe work, reduce to 2-3 occurrences max, varying the framing where possible.
